主要内容: The 2019 Genesis G70 has been named a "2019 Best New Car" by Autotrader. The award, agreed upon unanimously among Autotrader editors, recognized the G70's class-redefining merits, including its interior, which is described as a highlight that rivals cars costing tens of thousands of dollars more. Erwin Raphael, Chief Operating Officer of Genesis Motor America, stated that the award further recognizes the G70's outstanding positioning among luxury sport sedans. The G70 was selected from over 300 eligible new vehicles, with editors testing interior comfort, build quality, and performance. The G70, named the 2019 North American Car of the Year, resets benchmarks for luxury sport sedans with its integration of performance, body strength, refined luxury, and aerodynamic design. Pricing starts at $34,900. Genesis Motor America, based in Fountain Valley, Calif., is a global luxury automotive brand offering industry-leading warranty and services. In 2018, Genesis won awards for quality and owner satisfaction from J.D. Power, AutoPacific, and Strategic Vision. For more information, visit www.genesis.com or www.genesisnewsusa.com.
